nodes.label: Czech Live View Translations
nodes.rationale: Live camera controls as paired enable/disable keys per capability (camera, detect, recording, snapshots, audioDetect, autotracking, twoWayTalk, cameraAudio, streamStats), PTZ controls (move, zoom, focus, presets), lowBandwidthMode, suspend.forTime, and a manualRecording state machine (start/started/failedToStart/end/ended/failedToEnd, recordDisabledTips).
